name: rightmove
description: Multi-server Rightmove monitor with per-server drawn-area searches, filters, safe reconciliation, persistent scheduling, reliable embeds, price ordering, and configurable First Homes/affordable-scheme highlighting.
author: Five
install_msg: After loading, use `[p]rm setup #anchor <full Rightmove search URL>`. Use `[p]rm highlight on` before setup to mark First Homes, discounted-sale and first-time-buyer new-home listings with a star.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server configuration, Rightmove property metadata, Discord channel/message IDs, and scrape state. It does not store end-user personal data.
